items.name: FORMAT_VERSION
items.summary: The version of JSON output that this crate represents.

items.name: Abi
items.summary: The ABI (Application Binary Interface) used by a function.

items.name: AssocItemConstraintKind
items.summary: The way in which an associate type/constant is bound.

items.name: Attribute
items.summary: An attribute, e.g. `#[repr(C)]`

items.name: GenericArg
items.summary: One argument in a list of generic arguments to a path segment.

items.name: GenericArgs
items.summary: A set of generic arguments provided to a path segment, e.g.

items.name: GenericBound
items.summary: Either a trait bound or a lifetime bound.

items.name: GenericParamDefKind
items.summary: The kind of a [`GenericParamDef`].

items.name: ItemEnum
items.summary: Specific fields of an item.

methods.name: item_kind
methods.summary: Get just the kind of this item, but with no further data.

items.name: ItemKind
items.summary: The fundamental kind of an item. Unlike [`ItemEnum`], this does not carry any additional info.

items.name: MacroKind
items.summary: The way a [`ProcMacro`] is declared to be used.

items.name: PreciseCapturingArg
items.summary: One precise capturing argument. See [the rust reference](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/types/impl-trait.html#precise-capturing).

items.name: ReprKind
items.summary: The kind of `#[repr]`.

items.name: StructKind
items.summary: The kind of a [`Struct`] and the data specific to it, i.e. fields.

items.name: Term
items.summary: Either a type or a constant, usually stored as the right-hand side of an equation in places like [`AssocItemConstraint`]

items.name: TraitBoundModifier
items.summary: A set of modifiers applied to a trait.

items.name: Type
items.summary: A type.

items.name: VariantKind
items.summary: The kind of an [`Enum`] [`Variant`] and the data specific to it, i.e. fields.

items.name: Visibility
items.summary: Visibility of an [`Item`].

items.name: WherePredicate
items.summary: One `where` clause. ```rust fn default<T>() -> T where T: Default { T::default() } //                         ^^^^^^^^^^ ```

items.name: AssocItemConstraint
items.summary: Describes a bound applied to an associated type/constant.

items.name: AttributeRepr
items.summary: The contents of a `#[repr(...)]` attribute.

items.name: Constant
items.summary: A constant.

items.name: Crate
items.summary: The root of the emitted JSON blob.

items.name: Deprecation
items.summary: Information about the deprecation of an [`Item`].

items.name: Discriminant
items.summary: The value that distinguishes a variant in an [`Enum`] from other variants.

items.name: DynTrait
items.summary: Dynamic trait object type (`dyn Trait`).

items.name: Enum
items.summary: An `enum`.

items.name: ExternalCrate
items.summary: Metadata of a crate, either the same crate on which `rustdoc` was invoked, or its dependency.

items.name: Function
items.summary: A function declaration (including methods and other associated functions).

items.name: FunctionHeader
items.summary: A set of fundamental properties of a function.

items.name: FunctionPointer
items.summary: A type that is a function pointer.

items.name: FunctionSignature
items.summary: The signature of a function.

items.name: GenericParamDef
items.summary: One generic parameter accepted by an item.

items.name: Generics
items.summary: Generic parameters accepted by an item and `where` clauses imposed on it and the parameters.

items.name: Id
items.summary: An opaque identifier for an item.

items.name: Impl
items.summary: An `impl` block.

items.name: Item
items.summary: Anything that can hold documentation - modules, structs, enums, functions, traits, etc.

items.name: ItemSummary
items.summary: Information about an external (not defined in the local crate) [`Item`].

items.name: Module
items.summary: A module declaration, e.g. `mod foo;` or `mod foo {}`.

items.name: Path
items.summary: A type that has a simple path to it. This is the kind of type of structs, unions, enums, etc.

items.name: PolyTrait
items.summary: A trait and potential HRTBs

items.name: Primitive
items.summary: A primitive type declaration. Declarations of this kind can only come from the core library.

items.name: ProcMacro
items.summary: A procedural macro.

items.name: ProvidedDefaultUnstable
items.summary: Information about an unstable default provided by a trait item.

items.name: Span
items.summary: A range of source code.

items.name: Stability
items.summary: Stability information for an item.

items.name: Static
items.summary: A `static` declaration.

items.name: Struct
items.summary: A `struct`.

items.name: Target
items.summary: Information about a target

items.name: TargetFeature
items.summary: Information about a target feature.

items.name: Trait
items.summary: A `trait` declaration.

items.name: TraitAlias
items.summary: A trait alias declaration, e.g. `trait Int = Add + Sub + Mul + Div;`

items.name: TypeAlias
items.summary: A type alias declaration, e.g. `type Pig = std::borrow::Cow<'static, str>;`

items.name: Union
items.summary: A `union`.

items.name: Use
items.summary: A `use` statement.

items.name: Variant
items.summary: A variant of an enum.
